items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: I had a valet who had been with me for like 18 years, Curry Wilson

ctx.x: In the meantime, I had a valet who had been with me for like 18 years, Curry Wilson, what a doll. He had gone out and he had gotten the horn repaired. He got it all straightened out and everything, all the keys put back on, because it was a mess. I really -- it was bow-shaped, and I had a big bruise on my knee. They're pretty hard, you know, those sopranos.
But you felt better. This is really going back, but you felt better after you did it, didn't you?
